what: A second round of the art spike (plan T07b), after the owner said the paper cut-outs looked like a default and asked for a look that mixes abstraction and imagination. A magician and a critic in four directions, for the owner to pick from. Nothing here is read by the game.
note: failed/ has the first try of the collage direction, which came back as silhouettes because the prompt asked for a strong silhouette; the second try has its own prompt.
